title: Video player page with chapters
purpose: Player page for an existing MP4: chapters list and marker bar, optional captions and transcript, download link.
when: You already have a video (a motion export, a recording, a generated clip) and need a page to share and navigate it.
not_for: Making the video itself (use video-explainer, then point this template at its MP4).

src.description: MP4 or WebM file (copied to assets/) or a URL such as /report/x.motion/renders/x.mp4

duration.description: Only needed when the browser cannot read it (seconds or m:ss)

description.description: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs
